Do you enjoy shaping product portfolios, driving sales growth, and working in a fast-paced international environment? Hisense Europe Group is one of the leading international manufacturers of home appliances and consumer electronics, with a broad product portfolio and well-established brands including Hisense, Gorenje and ASKO. As we continue to strengthen our Small Domestic Appliances business across South-East Europe, we are looking for a Regional Trade Marketing Manager – SDA to join the SEER Regional Sales Organization. This regional role covers markets with different levels of maturity, customer landscapes and channel dynamics. Working at the intersection of regional SDA category leadership, Regional Sales and local market teams, you will coordinate trade marketing priorities across the SEER region. The primary objective of the role is to translate regional SDA category, customer and channel priorities into scalable sell-out programs, effective retail and omnichannel activation and measurable improvements in product visibility, market execution and trade marketing return on investment. We are looking for someone who understands how small domestic appliances are selected, presented and purchased and who can turn this understanding into practical programs that work across different SEER markets while adapting to local customer and channel needs. Key responsibilities Develop and propose the regional SDA trade marketing strategy, annual plan and priorities in alignment with category objectives, customer and channel priorities, brand guidelines and relevant Group standards. Translate category, customer and channel priorities into scalable sell-out programs, promotional platforms, shopper initiatives and retail activation models for different market and channel types. Define which trade marketing activities, tools and standards should be developed and managed regionally and where local markets should retain flexibility to adapt to specific customer and market needs. Establish regional standards for product visibility, displays, planograms, POS materials, product presentation, promotional execution and other relevant elements of retail and e-commerce execution. Lead the regional trade marketing workstream for priority product launches, strategic listings, seasonal campaigns and customer initiatives requiring coordinated execution across multiple markets. Propose priorities for the allocation of the regional SDA trade marketing budget, monitor approved spending and business impact, and recommend corrective actions or reallocation of investments within the applicable authority framework. Analyse sell-out results, incremental sales, customer and channel performance, shopper behaviour, competitor activities, retail execution quality and ROI, translating insights into clear recommendations and corrective actions. Prepare trade marketing inputs for the development of existing markets and entry into new markets, and lead the relevant trade marketing activities once initiatives are approved. Develop regional tools, briefs, guidelines, checklists and reporting models, provide functional support to local Trade Marketing teams and promote the exchange of successful practices across the region. Coordinate regional trade marketing priorities with Regional Sales, Regional Business Line Management, local Sales and Trade Marketing teams and relevant Product, Marketing, Finance, SCM and other functions. What we are looking for University degree in Marketing, Business Administration, Economics or a related field. At least five years of relevant experience in trade marketing, retail marketing, category management, commercial activation or a related area. Experience in small domestic appliances, consumer electronics, FMCG or another retail-driven industry is highly desirable. Experience in coordinating regional or multi-market initiatives and working within a matrix organization is an advantage. Demonstrated experience in product launches, retail activations, promotional programs and management of trade marketing budgets. Strong understanding of sell-out drivers, retail and e-commerce execution, customer and channel dynamics and promotional effectiveness. Ability to convert data and market insights into clear priorities, practical actions and measurable performance improvements. Strong analytical and commercial judgement, including experience in performance measurement and ROI evaluation. Ability to coordinate multiple markets and stakeholders without relying on direct hierarchical authority. Advanced Excel and presentation skills; experience with business intelligence tools is an advantage. Fluent English and willingness to travel within the region. What makes this opportunity distinctive You will have the opportunity to shape the regional trade marketing model for a strategically important and growing category. Your work will directly influence how SDA products are launched, presented and activated across markets and how regional scale is combined with local customer and channel needs. If you know how to connect category strategy, shopper understanding and disciplined retail execution to achieve measurable sell-out growth, we would be pleased to hear from you. Apply now if you are ready to take ownership of an exciting product category and contribute to the further growth of the Hisense brand in Serbia and BIH. We look forward to meeting you!
